title: Jay-Z Will Headline the Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show at SoFi Stadium
excerpt: Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show in Inglewood on February 14, 2027, and for the first time he will be the one on the stage rather than the one choosing who fills it.
body:
Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show in Inglewood on February 14, 2027, and for the first time he will be the one on the stage rather than the one choosing who fills it. The news came at the break of a Monday Night Football game between the Eagles and the Cowboys on October 26, and the statement that went with it began where his career did. "From *Reasonable Doubt* to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey. Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world's biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true," he wrote.

The announcement was made at once by the NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation, the company that has produced the show since the league struck the deal in 2019, and it came with a short film built around the choice itself. Hamish Hamilton will direct this one, and Roc Nation also serves as the strategic entertainment advisor of the live performance.

Until now, the artists on that stage came out of his own taste. Maroon 5 opened the run in 2020, and after them came The Weeknd and Rihanna, Usher, Kendrick Lamar and Bad Bunny, who took the stage in Santa Clara last February. The broadcast is where the announcement turns technical. The game returns to ABC after two decades away, and the telecast will run on ABC, ESPN and Disney+ at the same time, with NFL+ on mobile, the Spanish-language version on ESPN Deportes and Disney+, and a separate Spanish presentation on Univision.

[youtube:bHCRn9NZtPA]

Two days earlier he had closed out the run of shows he built around the thirtieth anniversary of his debut, with two nights in Inglewood on October 23 and October 24, after three July dates at Yankee Stadium and stops in London and Paris. The first of the two nights brought out John Legend and Blue Ivy Carter, and the second closed the tour with a West Coast showcase that included Dr. Dre.

His own channel has been filling with the official lyric videos tied to the HBO series *JAŸ-Z in 8*, eight chapters in which he and Rick Rubin go through the catalog one record at a time, with Rubin directing his own first film. The chapters run from the 1996 debut through "Kill Jay Z" and "Threat", and the title follows the way he now writes his name, with the Y capped and an umlaut over it. The eight episodes take in the eight albums of his catalog.

No guest has been announced yet, and the league has already started the guessing. "Anticipation as to who Jay-Z might have guest star at halftime for the big game will now kick off," the NFL said, adding that his wife, Beyoncé, will be at the top of the list. The idea was Roger Goodell's long before the date was set. When the league first reached its agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, he had one request, that the artist take the stage one day, whenever the moment felt right. The answer comes in February 2027, in front of a crowd that spent years guessing whether the man who chose the show would ever climb it himself.
